phases.objective: Add a deterministic, read-only readiness contract for a dedicated third persistence database while preserving safe degradation and separating runtime data, governance authority, migration authority, and durable response persistence.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The verifier reports blocked when RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_* is incomplete, reports ready only when the dedicated table authority and 16-column transport schema are both ready, and never executes a grant, migration, provider call, external write, or credential payload read.
steps: Resolve only the presence of RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_HOST, RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_NAME, RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_USER, and RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_PASSWORD without returning values.
Fail closed with runtime_persistence_configuration_missing when the dedicated configuration is incomplete and never fall back to DB_USER.
When configuration is supplied by the runtime, inspect direct table-scoped SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE readiness for governed_tool_response_chunks.
Inspect the current 16-column transport schema contract without issuing DDL or applying migration SQL.
Return ready only when both authority and schema are ready; otherwise return blocked with bounded no-secret evidence.
Keep migration 1048 as a separately governed apply step and keep Production grants, secret writes, provider mutations, and deployment outside this source PR.
Exclude feat/spec015-tenant-audit-convergence from the scope and recommendations.
assertions: A third persistence database is represented by RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_* and is not conflated with DB_* or GOVERNANCE_DB_*.
The readiness probe never exposes credential values and always emits secrets_included=false.
Missing dedicated configuration fails closed and fallback_to_db_user is false.
The required durable chunk authority is exactly SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE on governed_tool_response_chunks.
The readiness probe performs no grant, migration apply, SQL mutation, provider call, external write, or deployment.
Migration 1048 is the bounded transport-only migration path; migration apply remains blocked pending explicit governed authorization.
Safe degradation remains covered by the existing production write-authority regression test.
No path under feat/spec015-tenant-audit-convergence is modified or recommended.

phases.objective: Activate the third persistence database and prove schema and direct table privileges in Production without exposing credentials.
blockers: A third persistence database and restricted runtime user must be created by the authorized hosting/DB administrator.
Migration 1048 requires governed preflight, dry-run, explicit apply confirmation, and same-cycle schema readback.
RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_* secrets must be configured through the hosting secret manager without being committed or returned.
Production privilege readback and runtime durable recovery smoke are not performed by this source PR.

phases.objective: Extend the bounded write-authority readback to the selected dynamic audit and OpenAPI inventory tables after a separate Production authority decision.
No external provider write canary is introduced; the source slice is read-only and database-bound.
Treat durable response persistence as Production-ready only after exact source promotion, migration readback, restricted privilege readback, secret configuration, and recovery smoke pass.
blockers: No Production database grant or migration apply is authorized by this source PR.
No Production credentials are available to this execution context.
No deployment or provider mutation is introduced by this source PR.
